content: 世界上只有 10 种人：一种是懂二进制的，另一种是不懂二进制的。
程序员最讨厌康熙的哪个儿子？八阿哥，因为他是 Bug（八阿哥）。
在我的机器上明明跑得好好的！（It works on my machine!）——那么就把你的机器打包发给客户吧，于是容器技术 Docker 诞生了。
过早的优化是万恶之源（Premature optimization is the root of all evil）。—— 高德纳（Donald Knuth）
软件测试只能证明程序存在 Bug，永远无法证明程序没有 Bug。—— 艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉（Edsger W. Dijkstra）
Jeff Dean 在白板上用多项式时间解完了所有 NP 难问题，顺手证明了 P = NP。
gcc -O4 参数实际上并不是编译器优化，而是直接把你的源代码通过邮件抄送给 Jeff Dean 让他抽空重写一遍。
Jeff Dean 的网络 Ping 值是负数，因为光速嫌走得太慢，提前把数据包送过来了。
递归的最关键一步，是先理解什么是递归。要理解递归，请先参见‘递归’。
为什么程序员把键盘上的按键按得啪啪响？因为他们在用手速假装 O(1) 的时间复杂度，掩盖代码底层其实是 O(N!) 的尴尬。
如果建筑工人盖房子的方式就像程序员写软件一样，那么随便飞来一只啄木鸟就能摧毁整个人类文明。

A biologist, a statistician, a mathematician and a computer scientist are on safari in Africa. They see a single white zebra. Biologist: 'All zebras are white!' Statistician: 'There exists at least one white zebra.' Mathematician: 'There exists at least one zebra that is white on one side.' Computer scientist: 'Oh no! A special edge case!'
There are only two hard things in Computer Science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors.
Premature optimization is the root of all evil. — Donald Knuth
Testing can only prove the presence of bugs, not their absence. — Edsger W. Dijkstra
Jeff Dean proved that P=NP when he solved all NP problems in polynomial time on a whiteboard.
Jeff Dean's PIN is the last 4 digits of pi.
Jeff Dean can instantiate abstract classes.
When Jeff Dean throws an exception, it's across the room into the trash can.
To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion.
A programmer's wife tells him: 'While you're at the store, get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get a dozen.' He comes home with 12 gallons of milk.
Algorithm: A word used by programmers when they don't want to explain what they did.
It works on my machine. Then we'll ship your machine! And that is how Docker was born.
世上最漫长的等待：一是等待编译通过，二是等待 Git rebase 冲突解完，三是想退出 Vim 却无论如何退不出去。
硬件就是你在软件崩溃时，唯一能够用脚狠狠踹上去宣泄愤怒的物理实体。
Jeff Dean 在键盘上只用 0 和 1 两个键打字，后来他觉得 0 冗余了，于是只保留了 1。
There are only 10 types of programmers in this world: those who start array indexing at 0, and those who start indexing at 1.
Unix is simple. It just takes a genius to understand its simplicity. — Dennis Ritchie
A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and politely asks: 'May I JOIN you?'
